title: P08 — Adapt every pinned Hyperframes shader
description:
## Dispatch packet P08
Read canonical initiative videoml-dbc2b1 D03, D03a, D03b and D04 before editing. P07 and P12a are accepted and merged. Preserve all existing effect/asset/seed/timing behavior.

## Ownership and sequence
Own stdlib, player and toolchain only, on verified feature branches based on current main. Primary owns boards, commits and acceptance. Website consumes a frozen handoff later; do not edit its checkout. Follow D16: source work may run beside one other writer; browser/build/install/render operations require the primary-assigned heavy slot, with 8 GiB free floor.

1. Enumerate pinned Hyperframes shader registry at 28181602fe2d9ffa38474a6e8155a89909a7b8aa. Add failing coverage fixtures for the exact 14 keys. Adapt formulas/uniforms into the accepted P07 shared compositor and retain attribution and licenses.
2. Implement D03b parameter validation and composition-derived resolution. Preserve exact endpoints, explicit background compositing and documented upstream interior alpha semantics. Preserve correctly premultiplied crossfade.
3. Wire actual XML transition effect/props/ease and resolved source IDs into compositor in player and renderer. Advance both independently captured scenes at composition-absolute frames. Use P07 screenshot providers for general renderer scenes; native pixels or injected snapshot providers for browser preview. Missing provider is a named error; fallback must be explicit and diagnosed. Do not silently retain a CSS fade for shader XML.
4. Add owned runnable examples and per-shader schema/fixture/provenance metadata. Mark implemented only after behavior works; primary alone decides verified status. Do not claim full 470-entry completion.
5. With heavy slot, capture each shader at start/mid/end, reference-check opaque interior against pinned source, transparent endpoints and explicit background separately. Exercise repeated/reverse/random and partitioned seeks, non-default FPS/seed, easing, cancellation, invalid params/source IDs and explicit unavailable/fallback cases.
6. Prove actual XML player and CLI integration using isolated packed consumers and equivalent source pixels. Include real DOM/canvas/WebGL capture where applicable. Helpers alone are not acceptance. Return commands, source/pack hashes, actual logs/images and clear remaining gaps; no self-closure or commits.

## Exact coverage
All 14: domain-warp, ridged-burn, whip-pan, sdf-iris, ripple-waves, gravitational-lens, cinematic-zoom, chromatic-split, glitch, swirl-vortex, thermal-distortion, flash-through-white, cross-warp-morph, light-leak. Defaults and easing behavior are binding in D03b; do not improvise alternatives.

## Stop conditions
Do not weaken assertions, invent missing source or replace browser-painted evidence with SSR/html2canvas/foreignObject. No cloud operation, deployment, new framework ownership or silent fallback. Report unsupported capability accurately while continuing independent source work.
Primary correction: repair original catalog importer to enumerate unquoted as well as quoted shader keys; include shader/glitch under this packet and assert14 shader/470 total entries without dropping existing statuses/provenance. Source key enumeration must not execute arbitrary upstream runtime.
